title: How long does each Occupational Therapy session at Pinnacle last?
metaTitle: Occupational Therapy Session Duration - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand more about the duration and structure of Occupational Therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network. We customize our therapy duration to cater to the individual needs and comfort level of your child.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we adopt a child-centred approach for our Occupational Therapy sessions. Typically, a therapy session lasts for about 45 minutes to an hour. However, we customize this duration to suit the comfort and requirements of your child. Remember, our ultimate aim is your child's progress and wellbeing!
